Unlock in 2 minutes the exact measurement made by the Samsung charge controller. Everything happens on the phone: you authorize the app with a code shown by Android, once, and it is permanent.

The exact health value is protected by Android. To read it, the app pairs with this phone\'s own wireless debugging: the code shown by Android is how you grant access. One time only, everything stays on the phone.
Developer options are not enabled yet. Open the settings below, tap "Build number" 7 times to enable them, then come back here.
Open developer options, turn on "Wireless debugging" (Wi-Fi must be on), then choose "Pair device with pairing code". Tip: use split screen to keep the code visible, or memorize it.
Enter the 6-digit code shown by Android. The port is detected automatically as soon as the pairing dialog is open.

Solid line: measured points (100 %% at first use, then each capture). Dashed line: accelerating wear model, since a smaller battery needs more charge cycles per day and each cycle wears it a little more as it ages. Refresh the exact value from time to time to add points and sharpen the curve.
